```{r setup, include=FALSE}
# renv::restore()
options(scipen = 999)
conflictRules("n2khab", exclude = c("read_schemes", "read_scheme_types"))
conflictRules("git2rdata", exclude = c("pull", "meta"))
conflictRules("tidyr", exclude = "extract")
conflictRules("knitr", exclude = "spin")
conflictRules("kableExtra", exclude = "group_rows")
# Setup for googledrive authentication. Set the appropriate env vars in
# .Renviron and make sure you ran drive_auth() interactively with these settings
# for the first run (or to renew an expired Oauth token)
if (Sys.getenv("GARGLE_OAUTH_EMAIL") != "") {
    options(gargle_oauth_email = Sys.getenv("GARGLE_OAUTH_EMAIL"))
}
if (Sys.getenv("GARGLE_OAUTH_CACHE") != "") {
    options(gargle_oauth_cache = Sys.getenv("GARGLE_OAUTH_CACHE"))
}
lang <- params$lang
library(rprojroot)
projroot <- find_root(is_rstudio_project)
for (file in list.files(file.path(projroot, "R"), full.names = TRUE)) {
  source(file)
}
datapath <- file.path(projroot, "data")
for (subdir in c(
  "binary/intermediate"
)) {
  path <- file.path(datapath, subdir)
  if (!dir.exists(path)) dir.create(path, recursive = TRUE)
}
plotpath <- file.path(projroot, "plots")
if (!dir.exists(plotpath)) dir.create(plotpath, recursive = TRUE)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(stringr)
library(forcats)
library(purrr)
library(sf)
library(units)
library(terra)
library(git2rdata)
library(n2khab)
library(n2khabmon)
library(googledrive)

  echo = TRUE,
  dpi = 300
)
```
